statement: Whenever min_number_of_seconds(mountainHeight, workerTimes) returns a result r, r is the least nonnegative integer T for which there exist nonnegative integers x_0, ..., x_{n-1} satisfying sum_{i=0}^{n-1} x_i = mountainHeight and, for every i with 0 <= i < n, workerTimes[i] * x_i * (x_i + 1) / 2 <= T.
preconditions: mountainHeight is an integer with 1 <= mountainHeight <= 100000; workerTimes is a slice of integers with n = len(workerTimes), 1 <= n <= 10000, and 1 <= workerTimes[i] <= 1000000 for every i with 0 <= i < n.

statement: For every mountainHeight and workerTimes satisfying the preconditions, min_number_of_seconds(mountainHeight, workerTimes) returns a result r; in particular it does not fail, panic, index out of bounds, or report arithmetic overflow.
preconditions: mountainHeight is an integer with 1 <= mountainHeight <= 100000; workerTimes is a slice of integers with n = len(workerTimes), 1 <= n <= 10000, and 1 <= workerTimes[i] <= 1000000 for every i with 0 <= i < n.

statement: Whenever min_number_of_seconds(mountainHeight, workerTimes) returns r, there exist nonnegative integers x_0, ..., x_{n-1} such that sum_{i=0}^{n-1} x_i = mountainHeight and, for every i with 0 <= i < n, workerTimes[i] * x_i * (x_i + 1) / 2 <= r.
preconditions: mountainHeight is an integer with 1 <= mountainHeight <= 100000; workerTimes is a slice of integers with n = len(workerTimes), 1 <= n <= 10000, and 1 <= workerTimes[i] <= 1000000 for every i with 0 <= i < n.

statement: Whenever min_number_of_seconds(mountainHeight, workerTimes) returns r, for every integer T with 0 <= T < r there do not exist nonnegative integers x_0, ..., x_{n-1} such that sum_{i=0}^{n-1} x_i = mountainHeight and workerTimes[i] * x_i * (x_i + 1) / 2 <= T for every i with 0 <= i < n.
preconditions: mountainHeight is an integer with 1 <= mountainHeight <= 100000; workerTimes is a slice of integers with n = len(workerTimes), 1 <= n <= 10000, and 1 <= workerTimes[i] <= 1000000 for every i with 0 <= i < n.

statement: For an integer T >= 0 and an index i with 0 <= i < n, let cap_i(T) be the largest integer x >= 0 such that workerTimes[i] * x * (x + 1) / 2 <= T. Whenever min_number_of_seconds(mountainHeight, workerTimes) returns r, for every integer T >= 0, T >= r if and only if sum_{i=0}^{n-1} cap_i(T) >= mountainHeight.
preconditions: mountainHeight is an integer with 1 <= mountainHeight <= 100000; workerTimes is a slice of integers with n = len(workerTimes), 1 <= n <= 10000, and 1 <= workerTimes[i] <= 1000000 for every i with 0 <= i < n.

statement: Whenever min_number_of_seconds(mountainHeight, workerTimes) returns r, r >= min { workerTimes[i] | 0 <= i < n }.
preconditions: mountainHeight is an integer with 1 <= mountainHeight <= 100000; workerTimes is a slice of integers with n = len(workerTimes), 1 <= n <= 10000, and 1 <= workerTimes[i] <= 1000000 for every i with 0 <= i < n.

statement: Whenever min_number_of_seconds(mountainHeight, workerTimes) returns r, r <= min { workerTimes[i] * mountainHeight * (mountainHeight + 1) / 2 | 0 <= i < n }.
preconditions: mountainHeight is an integer with 1 <= mountainHeight <= 100000; workerTimes is a slice of integers with n = len(workerTimes), 1 <= n <= 10000, and 1 <= workerTimes[i] <= 1000000 for every i with 0 <= i < n.

statement: Whenever min_number_of_seconds(1, workerTimes) returns r, r = min { workerTimes[i] | 0 <= i < n }.
preconditions: mountainHeight = 1; workerTimes is a slice of integers with n = len(workerTimes), 1 <= n <= 10000, and 1 <= workerTimes[i] <= 1000000 for every i with 0 <= i < n.

statement: Whenever min_number_of_seconds(mountainHeight, workerTimes) returns r, r = workerTimes[0] * mountainHeight * (mountainHeight + 1) / 2.
preconditions: n = len(workerTimes) = 1; mountainHeight is an integer with 1 <= mountainHeight <= 100000; 1 <= workerTimes[0] <= 1000000.

statement: If r1 is the result of min_number_of_seconds(mountainHeight1, workerTimes) and r2 is the result of min_number_of_seconds(mountainHeight2, workerTimes), then r1 <= r2.
preconditions: mountainHeight1 and mountainHeight2 are integers with 1 <= mountainHeight1 <= mountainHeight2 <= 100000; workerTimes is a slice of integers with n = len(workerTimes), 1 <= n <= 10000, and 1 <= workerTimes[i] <= 1000000 for every i with 0 <= i < n.

statement: If r is the result of min_number_of_seconds(mountainHeight, workerTimes) and r2 is the result of min_number_of_seconds(mountainHeight, workerTimes2), then r = r2.
preconditions: mountainHeight is an integer with 1 <= mountainHeight <= 100000; workerTimes and workerTimes2 are slices of integers of the same length n with 1 <= n <= 10000, all entries in [1, 1000000], and workerTimes2 is a permutation of workerTimes (there is a bijection p on {0,...,n-1} with workerTimes2[i] = workerTimes[p(i)] for every i).

statement: If r is the result of min_number_of_seconds(mountainHeight, workerTimes) and r2 is the result of min_number_of_seconds(mountainHeight, workerTimes2), then r2 <= r.
preconditions: mountainHeight is an integer with 1 <= mountainHeight <= 100000; workerTimes is a slice of integers with n = len(workerTimes), 1 <= n <= 9999, and 1 <= workerTimes[i] <= 1000000 for every i; workerTimes2 is obtained from workerTimes by inserting one additional integer w with 1 <= w <= 1000000, so len(workerTimes2) = n + 1 <= 10000.

statement: If r is the result of min_number_of_seconds(mountainHeight, workerTimes) and r2 is the result of min_number_of_seconds(mountainHeight, workerTimes2), then r2 = c * r.
preconditions: mountainHeight is an integer with 1 <= mountainHeight <= 100000; workerTimes and workerTimes2 are slices of integers of the same length n, 1 <= n <= 10000, all entries of workerTimes2 are in [1, 1000000], and there is a positive integer c such that workerTimes2[i] = c * workerTimes[i] for every i with 0 <= i < n.

statement: Whenever min_number_of_seconds(mountainHeight, workerTimes) returns r, there exist nonnegative integers x_0, ..., x_{n-1} such that sum_{i=0}^{n-1} x_i = mountainHeight, for every i with 0 <= i < n workerTimes[i] * x_i * (x_i + 1) / 2 <= r, and there exists an index j with 0 <= j < n such that workerTimes[j] * x_j * (x_j + 1) / 2 = r.
preconditions: mountainHeight is an integer with 1 <= mountainHeight <= 100000; workerTimes is a slice of integers with n = len(workerTimes), 1 <= n <= 10000, and 1 <= workerTimes[i] <= 1000000 for every i with 0 <= i < n.
